name: allstackd
description: Email for your AWS AI agents: per-agent inboxes in your own SES/S3, drafts with human approval, guardrails.

interface.longDescription:
AllStackd gives each of your AI agents its own inbox inside your own AWS account. Mail arrives through Amazon SES into your S3 bucket, your agent reads and drafts replies through MCP, and nothing is sent until a person approves it. AllStackd stores metadata only; message bodies stay in your AWS account.

Use AllStackd when your agents run on AWS and need to receive and answer email under guardrails. It is not a cold-email or bulk-marketing tool, and it needs an AWS account.

Before using tools, sign in with OAuth, connect AWS in AllStackd, enable agent mail on a subdomain and create an inbox.
capabilities: Draft replies and request human approval
defaultPrompt: List my agent inboxes and summarize new threads
Draft a reply to the latest thread in support@ for my approval
